About Me

A creative partner, not just a one-off freelancer

I want to become the dependable person behind your brand's content — planning, designing, editing, and delivering on a consistent schedule.

Who I Am

I'm Biniyam Safayo, a graphic designer and video editor. I create social media graphics and short-form videos, and I support the full content process — planning, captions, publishing, and organized monthly delivery. I'm ambitious, disciplined, and results-focused.

How I Work

I offer monthly arrangements with clear deliverables, defined revision rounds, and agreed deadlines. Before we start, we align on platforms, volume, brand guidelines, approval process, and budget — so there are no surprises.

Ideally: your brand guidelines or references, footage/materials (or confirmation that I should source/create them), platform details, and your content goals. For video work, 2–3 reference videos you like help a lot.

Yes — publishing to your selected platforms is one of the support services I offer. We agree on posting responsibilities and access before the contract starts.

No — no honest editor can. What I guarantee is dedicated effort, strong hooks, platform-friendly editing, and consistent quality. Results depend on many factors outside anyone's control.
